tapSize.title: Tap Size Master
tapSize.description: Manage tap sizes and their measurements

userManual.title: Tap Size Master — How It Works
userManual.desc1: Tap Size Master defines the standard measurements of water taps available.
userManual.desc2: 1. Add tap sizes (e.g. 1/2 Inch, 3/4 Inch) along with their nominal size value and unit.
userManual.desc3: 2. Set the status of each tap size to Active or Inactive.
userManual.desc4: 3. Edit or delete existing tap sizes as needed.
userManual.warning: Always ensure the tap size is Active if it is currently being used for water billing.
